points.label: Covenant language
points.left: Hebrews contrasts priests made without an oath with Jesus’ sworn and permanent priesthood, then speaks of covenant, intercession, and one offering.
points.right: The argument’s main point names a seated high priest, a heavenly ministry, and a better covenant founded on better promises.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: The seated high priest has a better ministry founded on better promises

payload.tension: The argument moves from the priest’s permanence and intercession to his place, ministry, covenant, and promises.
payload.title: Lasting priesthood and better ministry
